description: This file defines the StatelessWorkerPlacement class, which implements a placement strategy for stateless worker grains in Orleans. It contains configuration properties like MaxLocal and RemoveIdleWorkers, constructors, and initialization methods.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerPlacement
classes.description: A placement strategy for stateless workers, supporting configuration of maximum local instances and removal of idle workers.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerPlacement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes MaxLocal and RemoveIdleWorkers, with default values.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes placement settings from GrainProperties, parsing configuration values.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties with current configuration values.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the placement strategy.
